theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_cs_coord_box_ftc
theorems.statement: ∀ (j : ℕ) (a : Fin (j + 1)) (r : ℝ) (φ ψ : (Fin (j + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ), 0 < r → Continuous φ → (∀ (u : Fin j → ℝ) (τ : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => ψ (Fin.insertNth a σ u)) (φ (Fin.insertNth a τ u)) τ) → ∫ u in {u : Fin (j + 1) → ℝ | ∀ i, |u i| ≤ r}, φ u = ∫ u in {u : Fin j → ℝ | ∀ c, |u c| ≤ r}, (ψ (Fin.insertNth a r u) - ψ (Fin.insertNth a (-r) u))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
